target: Spoiler-free 100% sandbox completion of The Sims: Legacy Collection and all seven included expansions

areas.name: Legacy Route and Save Safety
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, neighborhood selector, household save files, and six expansion destination buttons.
areas.note: Chosen route: native Windows Legacy Collection with the base game and all seven original expansions.

levels.1: Confirm the current complete Windows route before creating a long-term neighborhood.
levels.2: Install the Legacy Collection through a supported PC storefront.
levels.3: Update the game, launch it once, verify all seven expansion destination systems are present, and keep an untouched backup of the UserData neighborhoods before playing.

levels.1: Every completion system below depends on the full expansion stack.
levels.2: Confirm Livin’ Large and House Party first; then check Hot Date and Vacation; finally verify Unleashed, Superstar, and Makin’ Magic.
levels.3: Open the neighborhood and verify Downtown, Vacation Island, Old Town, Studio Town, and Magic Town travel options plus the expansion careers and objects. Stop if any pack is absent.

levels.1: A sandbox completion file accumulates many fragile household and character records.
levels.2: Back up the whole UserData neighborhood before major experiments.
levels.3: Close the game fully, copy the active neighborhood folder to a dated backup, and keep separate checkpoints before magical transformations, celebrity experiments, pet breeding, and large lot edits.

items.label: Max All Six Skills on One Sim

levels.2: Give one Sim ten points in every core skill.
levels.3: Use a stable adult Sim, alternate study and practice objects while maintaining needs, and verify all six skill bars display ten simultaneously.

items.label: Build a Full Career Friendship Network

levels.1: Most careers require household friends as well as skills.
levels.2: Maintain enough family friends for every promotion requirement.
levels.3: Use multiple household members to befriend neighbors, keep daily relationship values from decaying, and maintain the highest friend requirement while finishing each career.

items.label: Build a Fully Funded Completion Household

levels.2: Create a household that can buy every completion object without cheats.
levels.3: Reach the top careers, retain valuable rewards and souvenirs, and build enough liquid funds to purchase all required travel, Studio Town, Magic Town, pet, and crafting objects.

levels.1: Prepare food, music, space, and guest relationships before calling everyone over.
levels.2: Reach the strongest positive party outcome.

items.label: See a Failed House Party Outcome

levels.1: The opposite extreme has its own event response.
levels.2: Allow a separate backed-up party to collapse.
levels.3: Use a backup neighborhood, invite guests without adequate food or entertainment, let motives and relationships deteriorate, observe the failure response, then restore the clean backup.

levels.1: A well-planned outing should maintain both Sims’ needs and relationship.
levels.2: Finish a Downtown date with a clearly positive result.
levels.3: Choose a compatible partner, use dining and entertainment interactions, avoid long waits or motive failure, build the relationship throughout the outing, and return home after the positive conclusion.

levels.1: A backup lets you record the opposite result without damaging the main household.
levels.2: Finish a separate Downtown date with a negative result.
levels.3: Back up first, neglect the date’s needs and social progress until the poor result registers, then restore the clean neighborhood.
